title: Bad signature date_signed has inconsistent type
issue: For a timestamped signature with a modified payload or invalid signature, BadTimeSignature.date_signed can be an integer although callers expect a datetime. When a valid timestamp can be decoded, preserve the original signing time as a timezone-aware UTC datetime in error metadata. Keep the error type and payload behavior, and preserve None when a timestamp is missing or malformed. A public regression test reproduces the inconsistency.
public_test_origin: Upstream test-only diff from reference commit
